author: Insta360
description:
Insta360 Ace Pro 2 brings a new perspective to street photography.

In this video, we follow street photographer @GeorgeHolden as he puts the camera to the test in real-world urban scenarios, from candid portraits to close-up details, and even printing photos on the spot.

Powered by a Leica co-engineered lens and advanced in-camera color profiles, Insta360 Ace Pro 2 delivers image quality and color depth that go beyond traditional action cameras. With modular lens attachments like the Close-Up Lens and Ultra Wide Lens, plus the versatile Xplorer Grip Pro Kit, this setup becomes a compact, tactile tool for everyday street shooting.

In this video, you'll see: 
- Real-world street photography results
- Close-up Lens performance and manual focus with focus peaking
- Leica color profiles for photo and video
- Low-light performance with PureVideo
- Xplorer Grip Pro Kit handling and customizable controls
- On-the-spot photo printing in a live street environment
